title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or related STEM field.
qualification: Pursuing a CS/CE degree with proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python
description: Participate in designing, developing, and testing software solutions across Microsoft product lines.

title: Gates Cambridge Scholarship 2025
eligibility: Non-UK citizens applying to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree at the University of Cambridge.
qualification: Bachelor's degree with high academic achievement and outstanding leadership capacity
description: Full-cost scholarships for outstanding applicants from countries outside the UK to pursue a postgraduate degree in any subject available at the University of Cambridge.

title: Junior Frontend Developer
eligibility: Open to early-career developers globally with frontend development experience.
qualification: Bachelor's in CS or equivalent experience, knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript and Vue.js or React
description: Work on building intuitive user interfaces for GitLab's DevOps platform fully remotely.

title: Google Solution Challenge 2025
eligibility: University students worldwide enrolled in an undergraduate or graduate degree program.
description: Build a solution for one or more of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals using Google technologies.

title: Associate Product Manager
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of product management experience.
qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or relevant technical field
description: The APM program is an entry-level product management leadership development program at Google.

title: CS50: Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone globally, no prior programming experience required.
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan, teaching students how to think algorithmically and solve problems efficiently using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
